title: Give the names of the schools with the percent eligible for free meals in K
question:
Give the names of the schools with the percent eligible for free meals in K-12 is more than 0.1 and test takers whose test score is greater than or equal to 1500?
Benchmark knowledge evidence: Percent eligible for free meals = Free Meal Count (K-12) / Total (Enrollment (K-12)

auxiliary_raw_evidence_draft.base_sql:
SELECT DISTINCT s.XCL_042
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f ON s.XCL_041 = f.XCL_001
JOIN satscores sat ON s.XCL_041 = sat.XCL_030
WHERE f.XCL_020 > 0.1
  AND sat.XCL_035 >= 1500

base_solution_anchor.base_sql:
SELECT s.XCL_047
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f ON s.XCL_041 = f.XCL_001
JOIN satscores t ON s.XCL_041 = t.XCL_030
WHERE f.XCL_021 > 0.1 AND t.XCL_040 >= 1500;
